title: Generated isolated EmDash compose retains protected token custody
steps: Render short and long EmDash site labels with shared or isolated networks, with and without an access-key mount; send every output to both custody recognizers.
Mutate token and access mount sources, targets and permissions, aliases, network footers, mail, caps and token placement.
expect: All eight official generated forms are protected in JS and awk.
Every forged or hybrid form is unknown in both recognizers, never legacy none.
evidence: The local provisioned isolated EmDash Retry returned TOKEN_CUSTODY_UNKNOWN although its regular single-inode host token was root:root 0600. Before the fix six of eight current generator combinations failed; after the fix the matrix and negative mutations pass.
fence: Recognize exact shared and isolated generator forms; derive readonly access mount from this site's canonical parent; require caps, mail and a generator-slot protected token for new forms.

tests: EmDash current generated custody: long=false, isolated=true, access=true
EmDash current generated custody: long=true, isolated=true, access=true
EmDash current generated custody: long=true, isolated=false, access=true
